privacy.title: Privacy
items: This demo does not ask for your name, e-mail address or any account.
An access code identifies only a random number. The demo does not record who received a code.
The demo does not record your IP address in its application logs.
Price files that you upload stay in memory for a maximum of two hours. Only your code can use them.
Results of analyses that use your price file are visible to your code only. Analyses of public data (for example XU100) are shared and contain no data about you.
The hosting platform can keep technical logs (for example IP addresses) for its own security.
The output is for research and education. It is not investment advice.
The interface can be shown in Turkish. Reports are written in English.

footer.about: Multi-agent research that combines price indicators, news risk, the macro economy and company disclosures. Each figure in a report is checked against the source data.

step2.title: Provide Data & Disclosures
step2.subtitle: Equities need a daily price file (.xlsx or .csv).
step2.documentsOptional: A disclosure filing (.pdf, .png or .jpg) is optional.
step2.documentsOff: Document upload is off in this demo.
step2.whyTitle: Why do individual equities require historical price files?
step2.whyText: Borsa İstanbul equity prices are licensed data. Thus the engine analyses a daily price file that you can get yourself, for example from your brokerage or from İş Yatırım:
step2.uploadAsIs: Upload the Excel file without changes
step2.priceHelp: Accepts İş Yatırım historical export (.xlsx) or standard CSV format.
step2.evdsText: The engine gets the daily closing levels of the index from the Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye (EVDS). You do not need a file.
step2.documentHelp: A KAP filing or a scan of it (.pdf, .png or .jpg). Scanned pages are read with OCR.
step2.documentsOffText: Documents can contain personal data. Thus this demo does not accept them.
step2.allValidated: All necessary price files are validated.

upload.drop: Drag and drop the file here, or click to browse.

step3.title: Run Multi-Agent Analysis
step3.subtitle: A supervisor agent sends work to four specialists (technical, news risk, macro, disclosures). Each stage and each data request shows here as it happens.
step3.draftEmpty: The supervisor's report draft will appear here in real time.
